# Support

Ask questions in
[Discussions](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon/homometric-motion/discussions).
Use [Issues](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon/homometric-motion/issues/new/choose)
for reproducible software defects, missing assumptions, proof gaps and
counterexamples. Include the exact commit, Python version and verification
command; remove personal paths and confidential data.

The maintainer is [Thomas Albrecht](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon).
No email support or guaranteed response time is offered. This is experimental
research software, with no measured physical system or production service.
